messages:
ana: quick heads-up, i spun up Llama3-Base on H100/A100 with both fp16 and int8 in us-east/us-west/eu-west. looking at latency/throughput tradeoffs and a weird tail in eu-west after the recent edge routing tweak.
kevin: paste the numbers you have so far pls
ana: summary (small prompt mix):
- h100 fp16 us-east p50 44ms / p95 110ms
- h100 int8 us-east p50 36ms / p95 118ms
- a100 fp16 us-east p50 60ms / p95 170ms
- a100 int8 us-east p50 46ms / p95 200ms
- eu-west h100 fp16 p50 56ms / p95 290ms
- eu-west h100 int8 p50 48ms / p95 340ms
kevin: yikes eu-west tail is huge. was there a routing/proxy change last week?
maria: yes, we shifted some eu-west traffic through the new regional proxy POP to even out capacity. it increased average hop count by 1 for many requests.
sanjay: we instrumented hop impact: each extra proxy hop introduces ~30-70ms variance on p95 depending on cache warmness and kv-cache priming. int8's warmup fragility amplifies that tail.
nana: kernel note: using fused_attention kernels on H100 drops p50 by ~10-14ms and tightens p95 by ~25ms vs the generic path. on A100 the improvement is smaller.
nana: throughput (steady small prompts, per-gpu):
- h100 fp16 ~125 qps
- h100 int8 ~185 qps
- a100 fp16 ~92 qps
- a100 int8 ~150 qps
tess: so int8 is great for qps but hurts tail in eu-west due to warmup + added hop. need to consider SLA impact.
kevin: can you post the canary config you used so we can reproduce?
nana: canary snippet:
```
route_policy:
  primary: h100-eu-west
  fallback: a100-eu-west
  max_hops: 2
  kernel_preference: fused_attention
warmup:
  prefix_cache_ms: 300
  early_kv_load: true
metrics:
  collect_histograms: true
```
maria: prefix_cache_ms=300 is too low for heavy cold-start tails in eu-west. i bumped it to 900ms locally and saw p95 improve ~70-90ms.
sanjay: also recommend a micro-canary where we temporarily bypass the new proxy POP for 30m to isolate hop effect vs int8 behavior.
deploy-bot: canary initiated by ana at 2394441122 for route_policy + kernel_preference changes.
nana: proposed actions:
- kevin: run a 2h canary in eu-west with kernel_preference fused_attention and prefix_cache_ms=1000; collect p50/p95 + latency histograms + per-token traces.
- maria: run a 30m micro-canary disabling proxy POP to measure tail delta.
- sanjay: run quick perf microbench (10k requests) comparing H100 vs A100 across kernels and quant modes to validate qps and tail numbers.
- tess: draft SLA note and recommendations for region-specific routing/packing. include the small eval set to check quality regressions under int8.
kevin: scheduling the canary in ~40m, will post 30m snapshot here.
tess: pls also run the small prompt eval set i shared earlier so we can catch any subtle generation regressions under int8.
nana: initial quality check: differences are minor on our small eval set but i will attach the full eval diffs after the canary.
kevin: 30m snapshot posted — fused kernel helped p50 a bit and reduced p95, but eu-west p95 still ~70-90ms worse than us-east. histograms show a long tail cluster coincident with requests routed via the new POP.
maria: when i disabled the proxy POP for 30m, eu-west p95 dropped by ~110ms. strong signal that routing hop dominates the tail.
nana: good signal. after kevin's full canary we can choose among:
- prefer h100 for eu-west traffic while we resolve routing/pop issues
- increase prefix warming defaults regionally
- hold int8 rollout in eu-west until warmup/routing is stable
sanjay: note: a100 int8 still shows worse p95 vs h100 int8, likely due to kernel scheduling and memory bandwidth differences. keep that in mind for capacity planning.
nana: tagging @tess @kevin @maria @sanjay. i'll upload consolidated csvs and latency hist PNGs to the thread when canary completes.
tess: :thumbsup:
